notes.title: Check out the unmissable Curve Hidden Gems bundle
notes.content:
We’re thrilled to announce a new bundle, available to buy now on the Steam storefront! With its combined 40% discount, the Hidden Gems bundle features a whopping 18 classic titles from the Curve back catalogue!

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/48166/Curve_Games_Hidden_Gems

Taking in just about every genre you can think of, the Hidden Gems bundle is packed full of fan favourites that are guaranteed to keep everyone entertained over the Christmas holidays and beyond.

Already got some of these classics in your collection? No problem! As with every Steam bundle you won’t pay twice for any of the games you already own, making this the perfect way to round out your Curve collection.

Here’s every game included in the Hidden Gems bundle:

[list]
[*] 10 Second Ninja X - (Platformer)
[*] American Fugitive - (Action / Top-down shooter)
[*] Hotshot Racing - (Racing)
[*] Hue - (Puzzle platformer)
[*] Iron Fisticle - (Top-down shooter)
[*] Manual Samuel - (Funny / Adventure)
[*] Porcunipine - (Party game / Multiplayer)
[*] Pumped BMX + (Sport / Racing)
[*] Pumped BMX Pro - (Sport / Racing)
[*] Serial Cleaner - (Stealth / Funny)
[*] Skye Tales - (Platformer / Puzzle)
[*] Smoke and Sacrifice - (RPG / Adventure)
[*] Stealth Bastard Deluxe - (Stealth platformer)
[*] Stealth Inc 2: A Game of Clones - (Stealth platformer)
[*] Stikbold! A Dodgeball Adventure - (Party game / Sport)
[*] The Indie Mixtape - (Action / Adventure / RPG)
[*] Velocity®Ultra - (Sci-fi / Shoot ‘em up)
[*] When Ski Lifts Go Wrong - (Puzzle / Sports)
[/list]

There’s plenty for everyone in the Hidden Gems bundle, and it’s sure to keep you all nice and busy through these cold winter months!

The Curve Team

[b]And if that’s not enough…. Bomber Crew is for FREE during the publisher sale. Chocks away!  
[/b]

Will you risk the threat of betrayal and band together with fellow outlaws to end the Queen's oppressive reign?

[b]Defend to Automate. Automate to Defend. Wishlist NOW! The Autonauts need you, Captain! [/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1907720/

Up to 8 players! Crazy modifiers like low gravity, explosive collisions, bullet time, and many more. Find thousands of unique ways to play, customise your golf ball and race to the 18th hole! What are you waiting for?  Grab your Golf club (just kidding, a good mouse is enough) and gather your friends; it's time to Golf with the Gang!

Grab your friends and go try them on!

notes.title: Let’s Remote PLAY Together!
notes.content:
Let’s Remote PLAY Together!

There’s never been a better time to try out some of the best Curve Games with your friends!  

Thanks to Steam Remote Play Together, one player owns and runs the game, then up to four players can quickly join in the fun. 

Check out these links for more info: 
https://store.steampowered.com/remoteplay

[previewyoutube=pfQVhhWyLao;full][/previewyoutube]

Don’t own a Curve Game yet? We’ve got you covered with some great offers. Be the one your fiends flock to! 


Curve Games special sale starts the 28th of February until the 7th of March  


[b]The Ascent[/b]

This is the perfect time to dive in the incredible world of Veles with your friends with the new Remote Play Together feature and 40% discount on The Ascent! But this is not all, you can also enjoy 25% discount on the CyberSec Pack and 50% discount on the Original Soundtrack. Team up with your favourite friends/indents and survive The Ascent group collapse together!  


https://store.steampowered.com/app/979690/The_Ascent/

For The King  
 
Head on an adventure with your friends and bring peace to the kingdom of Fahrul in For The King with 66% off, and complete your collection and pick up the Lost Civilization Adventure Pack for 25% off. You can even enjoy the Original Soundtrack in the background as you play with 50% off. Delightful. Don’t forget to bring your friends along with you for free with Steam Remote Play!    
 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/527230/For_The_King/ 
 
Human Fall Flat 
 
With 19 incredible levels and a plethora of delightful costumes to wear, there’s never been a better time to join the Human: Fall Flat family – especially when it’s 66% off the regular price! On top of that, you can save 50% off the normal price of the Official Soundtrack right now, too. And thanks to Steam Remote Play Together, you’re able to share the fun of Human: Fall Flat with all your real life favourites Humans. 
 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/477160/Human_Fall_Flat/ 
 
Hotshot Racing  
 
Be quick and don’t miss the Hotshot Race and 70% off on the awesome Soundtrack. Arcade-style racing game with an incredible sense of speed to create an exhilarating driving experience for you and your friends. Drifting is an Art not a skill! Play it everywhere with whoever you want on Remote Play!  
 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/609920/Hotshot_Racing/ 
 
Steam Remote Play is the perfect opportunity to share other amazing games of our catalogue with friends and family. Great deals for everyone, what are you waiting for?

notes.title: Porcunipine Update 3 Out Now!
notes.content:
Hey guys!

We have a fresh new update ready!

- Integration and support for Windows 2-in-1 devices, you can play with up to 2 players using touch controls on those devices;
- As requested from some players we added a new menu option to turn blood and gore effects on and off;
- ... and minor bug fixes and performance improvements.

We hope you guys are enjoying the game! :)

- Big Green Pillow Team

notes.title: Porcunipine Update 2 Out Now!
Porcunipine Update 2 Out Now!
Porcunipine Update 1 Out Now!
notes.content:
Hey guys!

We’re very happy to announce some cool updates we’re releasing for Porcunipine!

- A brand new character!!! The purple one! He walks upside down!
- More detailed characters, with better animations and shadows;
- More detailed skulls with pop-up animations and sfx;
- ... and minor bug fixes and performance improvements.

Also, there are more cool stuff we’re working on for Porcunipine, including some prototypes for a (possible) future online multiplayer! So stay tuned for the upcoming updates :)

- Big Green Pillow
